## General

- Appointments are available in 30-minute slots, multiple slots can be booked for longer appointments.
    - Contact [MRI staff](../pages/people.qmd) if additional slots are needed.
- The MRI Safety Screen form is available [here](../resources/forms/form_RO01_mri_screen.pdf).
- A FOAPAL is required for MRI appointments:
    - MRI "No Shows" and cancellations <24 hours before the appointment are charged at 50% scan rate.
    - “Blocked out” time slots (e.g. reserving the scanner for a full day to support a data blitz) are billed for the entire block and not only the populated appointments.
- Additional resources (EEG, TMS, computing) will soon be available for booking.

**Use the booking buttons below to schedule rooms.**

## Zone 1

1. Two consultation rooms (B05, B06) are available for participant preparation.
1. A conference room (B26) is available for team and project meetings.

## Zone 2

1. Two interview rooms (B12, B13) are available for interviews, testing, and participant preparation.
    - Access: Level 1+
    - MRI Screening Required: NO
1. An MRI Simulator (Mock, B14) is also available to prepare participants for their MRI appointment. This does not have to occurr on the same day as the scan.
    - Access: Level 2+
    - MRI Screening Required: YES

## Zones 3-4

1. An MRI (B17) appointment books Zones 3 and 4.
    - Access: Level 2+
    - MRI Screening Required: YES

**Appointments are only confirmed when accepted by the MRI technologist.**
